question: How much of Jensen's supported-count advantage is caused by the five-player-only Everybody Gets a GPU Mandate, and which Mandate sources and supplier abilities scale with rival count?

factionTruth.protectedStrength: Compute abundance and supplier leverage remain unchanged.
factionTruth.bottleneck: The diagnostic changes only public Mandate from a table-wide distribution and measures dependence on rival count and demand.
factionTruth.eligibility: Disabling the GPU Mandate is not selected merely because it improves five-player parity. It must not conceal a separate three- or four-player Foundry advantage.

requiredDiagnostics: Foundry Mandate by source and player count
Allocation Window units sold and Runway gained
New Architecture licenses sold and Runway gained
Everybody Gets a GPU activations, rival Compute granted, and Mandate gained
paired win-share, score, and rank delta

selectionRule.candidate: Select removal of the GPU Mandate only if it materially corrects a five-player-only advantage without affecting three or four, preserves meaningful Round IV value, and the remaining Foundry rates do not require a different conversion diagnosis.
selectionRule.pairedAuthority: Compare the candidate only with canonical under common seeds. Positive paired rankDelta means improved placement.
selectionRule.integrity: Any integrity violation, policy fallback, unsupported-count gap, missing configuration-by-count accounting, or missing faction-specific Mandate-source accounting rejects the probe.
selectionRule.promotion: No physical text changes without a tracked receipt, complete surface audit, new immutable candidate, and explicit user approval.
